name: MlaPreprocessOperation

positions.description: shape (num_tokens,); int64; position indices for RoPE

q_lora_rank.description: int or None; if not None, use LoRA path for query

w_qkv_a.description: shape (q_lora_rank + kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim, hidden_size); fused QKV-A projection weight (used when q_lora_rank is not None)

w_q_b.description: shape (num_heads * qk_head_dim, q_lora_rank); Q-B projection weight (used when q_lora_rank is not None)

w_q_a_ln.description: shape (q_lora_rank,); Q-A LayerNorm weight (used when q_lora_rank is not None)

w_kv_proj.description: shape (kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim, hidden_size); KV projection weight (used when q_lora_rank is None)

w_q_proj.description: shape (num_heads * qk_head_dim, hidden_size); Q projection weight (used when q_lora_rank is None)

qk_nope_head_dim.description: int; non-RoPE head dimension; qk_head_dim = qk_nope_head_dim + qk_rope_head_dim

kv_c_normed.description: shape (num_tokens, kv_lora_rank); normalized KV compressed representation

reference:
import torch.nn as nn
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(hidden_states, positions, q_lora_rank, kv_lora_rank, qk_rope_head_dim, num_heads,
        w_qkv_a, w_q_b, w_q_a_ln, w_kv_a_ln, w_kv_proj, w_q_proj,
        qk_nope_head_dim, rope_base):
    device = hidden_states.device
    dtype = hidden_states.dtype
    positions = positions.to(device)

    num_tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
    hidden_size = hidden_states.shape[1]
    qk_head_dim = qk_nope_head_dim + qk_rope_head_dim

    if q_lora_rank is not None:
        qkv_lora = F.linear(hidden_states, w_qkv_a)
        q_c = qkv_lora[:, :q_lora_rank].contiguous()
        kv_lora = qkv_lora[:, q_lora_rank:].contiguous()
        q_c = F.rms_norm(q_c.float(), (q_c.shape[1],), weight=w_q_a_ln).to(dtype)
        q = F.linear(q_c, w_q_b)
        q = q.view(num_tokens, num_heads, qk_head_dim)
    else:
        kv_lora = F.linear(hidden_states, w_kv_proj)
        q = F.linear(hidden_states, w_q_proj)
        q = q.view(num_tokens, num_heads, qk_head_dim)

    kv_c = kv_lora[:, :kv_lora_rank].contiguous()
    k_pe = kv_lora[:, kv_lora_rank:kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim].contiguous()
    kv_c_normed = F.rms_norm(kv_c.float(), (kv_lora_rank,), weight=w_kv_a_ln).to(dtype)
    k_pe = k_pe.unsqueeze(1)

    half_rope = qk_rope_head_dim // 2
    arange_tensor = torch.arange(0, qk_rope_head_dim, 2, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
    inv_freq = 1.0 / (rope_base ** (arange_tensor / qk_rope_head_dim))
    freqs = positions.float().unsqueeze(-1) * inv_freq.unsqueeze(0)
    cos = freqs.cos()
    sin = freqs.sin()

    k_pe_2d = k_pe.squeeze(1)
    k1 = k_pe_2d[..., 0::2]
    k2 = k_pe_2d[..., 1::2]
    k_rot = k1 * cos - k2 * sin
    k_img = k1 * sin + k2 * cos
    k_pe_rotated = torch.stack([k_rot, k_img], dim=-1).flatten(-2).to(dtype).unsqueeze(1)

    q_nope = q[..., :qk_nope_head_dim]
    q_rope = q[..., qk_nope_head_dim:]
    q1 = q_rope[..., 0::2]
    q2 = q_rope[..., 1::2]
    cos_q = cos.unsqueeze(1)
    sin_q = sin.unsqueeze(1)
    q_rot = q1 * cos_q - q2 * sin_q
    q_img = q1 * sin_q + q2 * cos_q
    q_rope_rotated = torch.stack([q_rot, q_img], dim=-1).flatten(-2)
    q = torch.cat([q_nope, q_rope_rotated], dim=-1).to(dtype)

    return q, kv_c_normed, k_pe_rotated
description: MLA (Multi-head Latent Attention) preprocessing operation. Performs linear projections (fused QKV-A or separate Q/KV projections), RMSNorm on compressed representations, and GPT-J style RoPE rotary position embeddings to prepare inputs for the attention kernel. The operation supports two paths: (1) LoRA path when q_lora_rank is not None, which uses fused_qkv_a_proj to project hidden_states into [q_c | kv_c | k_pe], applies RMSNorm to q_c and kv_c separately, then projects q_c through q_b_proj to get the full query; (2) Direct projection path when q_lora_rank is None, which uses separate kv_a_proj and q_proj. RoPE uses GPT-J style interleaved rotation (is_neox_style=False) with configurable base frequency. Common in DeepSeek-V2/V3 models with hidden_size 5120-7168, num_heads 128, kv_lora_rank 512, qk_rope_head_dim 64, qk_nope_head_dim 128, rope_base 10000.
